messages:
Anya: Heads up — noticed a perf + quality regression on Mixtral-8x after the kernel-selector rollout this morning. Latency P95 up ~18% and some evals show weird token collapse on long prompts.
Raj: Can you paste the rollout flag i.e. what selector order we pushed?
Anya: We flipped selector to prefer `tiling` over `matmul` for seq>1024 to reduce memory spikes. Deploy command: `rdwctl rollout set kernel_selector=tiling,matmul --target mixtral-8x`
Maria: Repro steps + short artifacts: I ran the long-context eval (max_len 8192) against canary and prod. Canary (new selector) produces repeated "the the the" after ~1800 tokens for ~12% of prompts. Prod (old selector) is fine. Attached eval diff (snippet):
```
--- good
+ bad
prompt: <long legal contract...>
good: "...the agreement is executed by both parties."
bad:  "...the agreement is executed the the the the the"
```
Raj: Oof. Any kernel-level metrics? KV hit/miss, batch sizes, GPU occupancy?
Anya: Quick profile from canary pod (samples):
```
GPU util: 68% -> 50% after swap
Avg batch size: 2.4 -> 1.9
KV cache read latency: 0.9ms -> 1.6ms
CPU steal: 0.5% -> 3.2%
```
Also saw increased micro-pauses in the tiled attention path on head counts != 16.
Ed: Could be a head-dim alignment issue with tiling kernels; Mixtral has non-power-of-two kv dims. Tiling assumed packed heads in 64-blocks — might be spilling to slow path and causing mis-ordered attention scoring, which can manifest as quality drop.
Maria: I ran an ablation: forcing `--kernel-selector=matmul` on the same canary eliminates the collapse and restores latency but bumps peak memory as expected. So regression is selector-path dependent.
Raj: Is quantization involved here? We toggled 4-bit qconfig last week.
Anya: Not in this rollout. This change was selector-only. Quantization flags untouched.
ci-bot: Deploy 1995012100 succeeded to mixtral-8x-canary at 08:12 UTC; selector flag applied via feature-flags service.
Ed: Next steps I propose: 1) pin canary back to `matmul` to stop customer-facing quality issues, 2) reproduce with synthetic microbench to isolate head-dim alignment, 3) add more detailed KV access tracing on tiled path (low-overhead sample).
Maria: +1 to pin. I'll open an eval-only canary with extra logging and re-run the 1k long prompts overnight.
Raj: If it's kernel packing assumptions, we should also check our kernel-compile-time heuristics for Mixtral variants (head_count mod 8/16). Add unit tests for non-aligned head dims.
Anya: Rolling back canary to `matmul` now and creating an issue with the profiling output + one failing example for QA. Tagging @Ed for kernel triage. :rotating_light:
Ed: I'll bisect the tiled-attn path this afternoon. If it's reproducible in microbench, we can either adjust tiling heuristic or add a fallback that preserves numerical ordering for non-aligned dims.
Maria: Filing the thread in GH: rdw/inference#7543 with logs + eval diff.
ci-bot: Canary rollback initiated by Anya at 08:37 UTC.
Anya: Thanks team — will follow up tomorrow with the overnight eval results.
